card.name: Linking words in exposure–outcome phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "and", "of" or "with" that join an exposure to an outcome. Typical settings are "X and the risk of cancer", "associated with" and study titles about links between a factor and a disease.

modes.label: "and" between exposure and outcome
modes.description: The word "and" links a drug, habit or condition to a disease outcome in a study title or citation.
modes.example: A meta-analysis of alcohol drinking<< and>> oral and pharyngeal cancers.

modes.label: "of" or "with" in association phrases
modes.description: "of" or "with" comes right after risk, rate or associated, before the outcome.
modes.example: the association between DMPA-IM use and the risk<< of>> breast cancer are summarized in Figure M.

card.writes: The suppressed and promoted tokens look unrelated to the text, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on the small word that links a cause or exposure to a disease in phrases like "use and the risk of cancer".
